title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.5 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 05:36 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 438 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Sunny's having an easy shift. 🌎💛

A broad dark coronal-hole region is the main visible feature on today’s solar disk; no prominent sunspot group is apparent.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
